title: Nanna
summary_html: Nanna is an elderly woman responsible for the management of the nursery in Castle Britannia in Ultima VII. She also appears in a more generic capacity as a domestic worker in Ultima Underworld II, where she leads the other castle workers in protesting their unjust societal position.
